# agent-task-queue

> In-memory priority task queue for agent workers in Go: leases with tokens, retries with capped exponential backoff, a bounded dead list and an injected clock Go module `github.com/Trysac/u226-agent-task-queue`, package `agenttaskqueue`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
